name: Disheartening Darkness
body:
School evocation [darkness, despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 3, bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, death mage 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a piece of coal and a raven feather)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (see text); Spell Resistance no (see text)

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell darkness except that any who enter the affected area must make a Will save or be afflicted with the doubting condition. If the creature has spell resistance, it applies to the condition. If a creature leaves the area of darkness, they are no longer affected by the doubting condition. However, any creature, including those who have left the area, who enter the radius of darkness are subject to making the Will save.
